title: Little Leaf music provenance and licence addendum
scope: The three unchanged Little Leaf Cafe release 1.1 MP3 recordings listed below; this is not a blanket clearance of the whole game or other music.

conclusion.qualification: GeneralUser GS supplier permission is documented. Its stated uncertainty about some historical sample origins remains. This is not an independent ownership or non-infringement guarantee.

checked_package.audio_contents: Only the three MP3 recordings; no SoundFont, MIDI, or FluidSynth shared library is included.

production.composer: Original music created by the assistant for Little Leaf Cafe
production.method: Locally authored note and arrangement events, rendered with a sampled-instrument SoundFont; no generative-music service was used in the reported production.

soundfont.name: GeneralUser GS
soundfont.creator: S. Christian Collins
soundfont.historical_sha256_status: unverified; no checksum substituted from another project or fresh download

production.preset_numbering: Zero-based SoundFont bank/program values; quiet variant has no hand-percussion notes.
production.other_audio_inputs: None in these BGM recordings according to the executed source record. All seven stems use the same GeneralUser GS file; no imported song, melody, loop, second sample bank, or external impulse response.
production.effects: NumPy/SciPy filtering and circular delays of the rendered signal; release-tail wrapping, static mixing and master gain.
production.sfx_scope: Separate procedural game foley from make_sfx.py was not mixed into these BGM recordings and is not audited here.
production.release_1_1: Two first-bar note-velocity reductions; later content retained according to the historical production report. This addendum does not reperform the old PCM comparison.

evidence.verification: Original composer re-read the original executed command/source outputs on 2026-10-03 and supplied exact excerpts. Current auditor did not re-run the missing composition sources.
evidence.finding: Copied the GeneralUser GS bank and its licence from cinematic_score_v3; loaded that bank with fluid_synth_sfload and enumerated the six used presets successfully.

evidence.verification: Original composer reports the full contemporaneous licence read in the executed production record.
evidence.finding: GeneralUser GS v2.0.3 / Licence v2.0, matching the official text independently retrieved for this addendum.

evidence.verification: The original composer supplied the exact three SHA-256 values from the recorded executed output.
evidence.finding: All three values match the independently hashed MP3 bytes inside the checked 0.1.1 editable archive.

evidence.verification: Independently hashed the current archive and each embedded MP3; matched the Library build receipt and historical track values.

evidence.note: A current copy fetched from the official creator repository, not the missing historical local licence file.

licence_summary.recorded_music_permission: Private and commercial music creation and profit from recordings are permitted by the supplier licence.
licence_summary.attribution: No express attribution requirement for rendered music was found in the supplied licence; optional credit may name GeneralUser GS and S. Christian Collins.
licence_summary.website_condition: When featuring GeneralUser GS on a website, link to the creator website rather than directly to its download files, or host a permitted local copy. This addendum does not distribute the bank.
licence_summary.residual_caveat: The creator states that some sample sources cannot be established with complete certainty. The licence therefore does not provide independent proof of every underlying sample origin.

limitations: The original composition directory, MIDI, stems and original SoundFont bytes have not been recovered.
The exact historical SoundFont checksum is unverified.
This addendum distinguishes reported historical execution evidence from independently repeated current file-hash and official-licence checks.
The soundfont supplier's sample-origin caveat remains; no legal guarantee or blanket whole-game clearance is made.

preservation.apply_to: New release candidates only, after verifying the three exact MP3 hashes. Preserve historical archive bytes and historical recovery records.
preservation.supersedes: The former missing-provider/missing-licence assessment for these exact three tracks; it does not erase the historical fact that their source files were missing during the October 1 recovery.
